PegInsertionSide_m128.declared_basis: The m=64 regeneration run and the m=128 run share these contexts, so their step gaps are identical and the fingerprint cannot say which IG run produced the rankings. Primary by chronology: the Month 4 execution log records the seed-less, budget-less m=64 regeneration sidecars first, then E2 m=128 IG (seed 42 then seed 142, overwriting the same ep000 to ep007 paths), then E5 m=128 faithfulness after E2 on the same GPU, so the shared paths held the seed-142 m=128 sidecars when E5 read them (notes Month 4/4.6, Month 7/7.1). The alternative qualified m=64 file is reported as a separate grouping.
